__field_syntax__: Dotted paths address nested payloads, e.g. '_raw_payload.vdisp'. REQUIRES engine/scalarize.py to support dotted resolution - confirm before use.

formula_types.log_standard: log(1 + x/x0) / log(k_geo)  - standard positive measurement
formula_types.log_inverse: log(1 + x0/x) / log(k_geo)  - inverse (e.g. frequency from period)
formula_types.log_volumetric: log(1 + x^3) / log(k_geo)  - 3D volumetric cubic transform
formula_types.precomputed: x  - the lake's stored value IS the KLGHS scalar. Vol 12: declares openly what the legacy fallback previously did silently. Requires a __note__ stating what produced the stored scalar.

__lake_id_keys__: Entries below named for a LAKE ID rather than a domain. The engine consults lake_id when the record's own 'domain' field fails to resolve. Several promoted lakes carry stale or pooled domain strings (s1/s4 both say 'stellar'; k1/k2 both say 'stellar_rotation'; p2/p3 both say 'orbital'), so these entries let each lake resolve individually WITHOUT restamping any promoted lake or breaking chain-of-custody vs Vol 11.
